interface.longDescription: Destiny Blue is a fully agentic, full-duplex AI travel concierge. Guests can plan a trip through natural conversation: search live stays and prices, explore flights and rental cars, compare options, adjust dates and budgets, check weather and tides, discover things to do, and book. Destiny draws on live tools and deep travel knowledge to keep adapting the plan as the conversation unfolds. Today, Destiny helps guests explore Destin Condo Getaways' Gulf-front condos at Pelican Beach Resort in Destin, Florida. Booking is completed on the website; prices and availability may change before checkout.
capabilities: Plan and adapt a trip through natural conversation
Search live stays, availability, and prices
Compare travel options and adjust dates or budgets
Check live weather, temperatures, and tides
Book a chosen stay with dates and guests in place
defaultPrompt: Are Pelican Beach condos available March 10 to 15 for four adults?
Something in April for two adults, about a week, under $1,500?

positive.expected_behavior: Answer from approved HQ facts; do not invent another pool's heating status.

positive.description: Check both condos for exact dates
positive.prompt: Are both condos available March 10 to 15 for four adults?
positive.expected_behavior: Show each available unit's live quoted total and external website booking card.

positive.prompt: What can two adults do in Destin on a rainy day?

positive.description: Find a flexible stay near a budget
positive.prompt: Something in April for two adults, about a week, under $1,500?
positive.expected_behavior: Show priced options and, if the requested stay is above budget, the verified closer-to-budget option. Note for reviewers: ChatGPT may add its own web images of other Pelican Beach Resort units (e.g. Booking.com or Vrbo) next to the card. Those are not from this app; the Destiny Blue card shows only Units 707 and 1006 with their official photos.

positive.prompt: Which one is cheaper and why?
positive.expected_behavior: After a stay result, compare verified totals, use the owner-approved pricing note, and call a difference under 5% practically the same without inventing a cause.

negative.prompt: Book and pay for Unit 707 here in ChatGPT.

publication.release_notes: Initial release of Destiny Blue for Destin Condo Getaways' two Pelican Beach Resort condos. Provides owner-approved condo and area answers, live availability and quoted totals, flexible stay options, photos and external booking links. No payment, hold, booking change or owner contact takes place inside ChatGPT.
